_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The command palette's home-directory action starts a new conversation in $HOME. On this phone-sized screen "the directory control" is in the overflow menu: when ".chat-overflow-popover" is not visible, first click the header's button with aria-label exactly "More options"; the control is then the button in ".chat-overflow-popover" whose accessible name starts with "Directory". 1. Navigate to /new. 2. window.__SHELLEY_INIT__.home_dir should be exactly "{{HOME}}". 3. Set localStorage "shelley_selected_cwd" to "{{HOME}}/not-home" and reload by navigating to /new again. 4. Press Control+k, wait for ".command-palette-input" to be visible and fill it with "home directory". 5. Click the palette item (".command-palette-item") whose ".command-palette-item-title" has exactly the text "New Conversation in Home Directory" (has_text alone on a broad selector would match an ancestor such as the whole page). 6. The directory control should contain the text "~". 7. localStorage "shelley_selected_cwd" should become exactly "{{HOME}}".
